cases.claim: “. . . low blood pressure and fainting in certain settings . . . [,]” | [Omission] all contraindications; Boxed Warning details (alcohol close in time — wait at least 2 hours after 1–2 drinks; CYP3A4 inhibitors; liver problems); CNS depression W&P; hypotension/syncope with Addyi alone
cases.context: Boxed Warning for hypotension and syncope. Prior OPDP advisory comments (2016) to Valeant.
cases.rationale: Omits contraindications and material Boxed Warning/W&P facts; misleading safety impression.
cases.check: Rule: diff risk content vs Boxed Warning sub-elements, all contraindications and W&P headings.

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: “1 in 10 premenopausal women suffer from frustrating low libido, also known as HSDD.” | “Meet Addyi – the first and only FDA-approved non-hormonal pill for acquired, generalized HSDD in premenopausal women. In other words: An FDA-approved pill for women frustrated by their low libido.” | “Ladies, add your desire back with Addyi.”
cases.context: Indication excludes HSDD due to medical/psychiatric condition, relationship problems, or drugs; not for postmenopausal women, men, or sexual performance.
cases.rationale: Omits indication exclusions and limitations of use; suggests approval for all women frustrated by low libido.
cases.check: Rule: flag lay paraphrases of the indication ('in other words') that drop PI exclusions/limitations of use.
